name: Lyo.ChangeTracker.Postgres
tagline: PostgreSQL adapter for `Lyo.ChangeTracker`. Stores entity-scoped change history using `Lyo.EntityReference.Models.EntityRef` for both the target entity and the optional actor.
description: PostgreSQL adapter for `Lyo.ChangeTracker`. Stores entity-scoped change history using `Lyo.EntityReference.Models.EntityRef` for both the target entity and the optional actor.
features: EF Core migrations in the `change_tracker` schema (`PostgresChangeTrackerOptions.Schema`)
Queryable history by entity type, entity, or change id (newest first)
`DeleteForEntityAsync` drops all history for a target entity
Optional automatic migrations on startup via `EnableAutoMigrations`

examples.title: Migrations
examples.code:
export CHANGE_TRACKER_CONNECTION_STRING="Host=localhost;Database=change_tracker;Username=postgres;Password=postgres"
dotnet ef migrations add MigrationName --project Core/ChangeTracker/Lyo.ChangeTracker.Postgres

sections.title: Registration
rows: Binds `PostgresChangeTrackerOptions` from `"PostgresChangeTracker"` (override the section via the optional `configSectionName`) and registers as above.
Builds options from a raw connection string, registers the factory, and exposes a scoped `ChangeTrackerDbContext`.
Calls `AddChangeTrackerDbContextFactory` and registers `IChangeTracker` → `PostgresChangeTracker` as a singleton.
Same as the options overload, binding from configuration.

sections.title: Health
sections.text: `HealthCheckName = "change-tracker-postgres"` comes from `PostgresChangeTracker` implementing `Lyo.Health.IHealth`. The probe constructs a `ChangeTrackerDbContext` and calls `Database.CanConnectAsync`. Schema name is placed in the `HealthResult` data bag. Hosts resolving `IEnumerable<IHealth>` pick this tracker up.

sections.title: Database schema
items: `change_tracker.changes`. Subject (`for_entity_*` / `SubjectEntityType`), optional actor (`from_entity_*` / `ActorEntityType`), nullable `tenant_id` (uuid), JSON `OldValues`, JSON `ChangedProperties`, optional `ChangeType` / `Message`, and `Timestamp`.
